messages:
tara-peopleops: Quick announcement — Spring compliance attestation window is live now through May 10 23:59 UTC. All employees and contractors with Redwood accounts must complete the attestation or upload evidence by the deadline. Form + Evidence Locker: https://redwood.example.com/spring-attest-2026 :calendar:

tara-peopleops: Short checklist: 1) Fill the attestation form. 2) Upload supporting artifacts to the Evidence Locker (link in form). 3) Team leads confirm their direct reports. Contractors: if your start date overlaps the window, flag them in the form by May 6 to request a 5-day extension.

ben-engmgr: For eng teams: we'll collect at squad level. If your squad needs help bundling evidence, DM me and I'll coordinate a lead submitter.

sam-security: Minimal artifacts by team type: infra = CMDB screenshot or asset export + access control note; services = brief dataflow + encryption config screenshot; integrations = vendor contract excerpt + data handling note. If unsure, upload and mark "for review".

ima-privacy: Reminder: complete the annual privacy micro-course before attesting. The form will surface the training link if your record is missing it. Try to finish training by May 8 to leave time to upload proof.

pulse-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Spring attestation window open" will also post in #general on May 2 09:00 UTC and send an email digest on May 7.

tara-peopleops: Office hours with people-ops + security: May 4 15:00-16:00 UTC and May 9 10:00-11:00 UTC. Sign-up link is in the form for 1:1 reviews.

sam-security: We'll triage uploads as accepted / needs info and aim to close reviews by May 20. For urgent audit priorities tag @sam-security in the form.

tara-peopleops: TL;DR: attest/evidence due May 10 23:59 UTC; privacy training done by May 8; contractor flags by May 6; office hours May 4 & May 9. Please share with any vendors you manage. :white_check_mark:
